note: Options positioning read at the Fri 11/20 close (weekend: prices and walls are where Friday's close left them; open interest refreshes before Monday's open, so walls can move). Descriptive only, not a forecast. 'Magnet' = biggest gamma strike for that expiry. Regime = price at the close vs that expiry's flip (NEG where no flip was shown: negative gamma the whole way). All expiries combined: every index board is negative gamma with no flip. SPX biggest strike moved 7200 → 6500 (also its put wall; price is about 410 points above it) and its 6835 call wall is now below price; SPY's biggest strike held at 700, now above price, ceiling 721 (was 765); QQQ's biggest strike moved 650 → 600 (also its put wall), call wall 603 (was 679); NDX 27000 → 24000, call wall 26050. Weekly map (Nov 23–27): SPY 700 · ceiling 721; QQQ 600 · 603; SPX 6500 · 6835; VIX 35.90 boxed 18 to 40 (its wall moved up from 30 to 40); SMH sits on its 400 floor. Thanksgiving week: Thu 11/26 closed, Fri 11/27 closes early and is the weekly expiration. /ES levels are SPX levels converted with the Fri session basis (ES − SPX median during the regular session, +16.5). Wednesday midweek note (11:28 AM PT): the Friday figures on this board have not been refreshed and are not current. A Wednesday morning print still had SPY 700 as a put wall. VIX is 27.97 (Wednesday high 34.95 at 6:45 AM PT), not the Friday 35.90 close. ES ≈ SPX + 13.5 as of Wednesday 11:18 AM PT (session still open), tighter than Friday's +16.5.
